title: Degree-sum formula (handshaking lemma)
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$, and for each vertex $v$ write $d(v)$ for its degree, the number of vertices adjacent to $v$. Then \[ \sum_{v \in V} d(v) = 2\,\abs{E(G)}, \] where $\abs{E(G)}$ is the number of edges of $G$.
